source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES sends the complete GPU1_M-to-GPU8_M expression as one literal sensor and truncates fallback data. It cannot prove eight records or establish `_M`, component identity, electrical boundary, controller scaling and UI parity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly requires suffix decoding and separate records but lists memory/module/input/output as possibilities. The exact `_M` meaning remains Project-defined and must be explicitly distinguished from the adjacent non-M family.

old_problem: The source does not define `_M`; memory, module, motherboard, mezzanine or a monitor-channel tag would imply different components and electrical boundaries. A literal range or reuse of the non-M result could omit eight independent channels, and dynamic load language from another case could be incorrectly imported into this passive UI check.
disposition_reason: Keep `_M` literal until the platform power tree defines it, then bind each of eight records to a physical GPU/component and exact power-monitor channel and boundary. Capture all eight passive readings and both UI views with aligned timestamps and unchanged GPU state. Project-specific suffix/boundary/limit inputs are runtime prerequisites; they do not require another engineering decision.
decision_basis: XLSX row 899, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, selection manifest, adjacent non-M row, related dynamic/list rows and the preserved V3.1 record were directly reviewed.
Related use of the word module is only a clue; it is not authority to expand `_M` as module or memory, nor to select a rail/register.
This passive Sensor Page identity does not inherit workload or threshold-event stimulus from a different test. Eight `_M` outcomes remain independent of eight non-M outcomes.
ED-03 prevents OEM monitor guessing, ED-15 requires boundary/state/window-specific criteria, ED-17 preserves logs and ED-20 prevents merging the two GPU power families.

test_case.test_name: Verify PWR_GB_GPU1_M through PWR_GB_GPU8_M as eight Project-defined M-labeled power channels
test_case.purpose: Verify every `_M` GPU-related power record is separately present or has an approved absent/powered-off outcome, maps to its authoritative physical GPU/component and monitor field, and presents the correct quantity, units, value, health, supported thresholds and freshness in Dashboard and Server Health under the unchanged passive state.
required_package: Chassis/GPU-baseboard, BIOS, BMC/SDR and monitor-controller identity plus authoritative `_M` definition and explicit difference from the non-M family
Eight-row physical position, component/module identity, GPU PN/serial/UUID/BDF/VBIOS/FW, presence and power-state map
Per-record electrical boundary, quantity/units and monitor controller/bus/mux/address/channel/register identity
Per-channel scaling, accuracy, averaging/integration window, update/polling rules and stable SDR/API/UI names
Approved boundary/state-specific tolerance/limit, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, stale and unavailable behavior
Recorded driver/persistence, clocks, power cap, processes/workload, fan/inlet/airflow and any approved boundary-equivalent telemetry
Validated protected read-only BMC/browser client and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual method
test_case.test_command: Preserve SEL, kernel, NVIDIA XID, power and thermal logs. Do not expand `_M` from its letter or borrow the non-M/dynamic-test interpretation. Build the approved eight-row `_M` component/monitor matrix, enumerate the full sensor repository and query all exact records separately; never use the tilde expression as one sensor. Review the Script before use. Capture each record's stable identity, physical GPU/component/UUID/BDF, monitor field, electrical boundary, quantity/units, value, supported thresholds, health and synchronized timestamp plus matching Dashboard and Server Health visual rows. Record the unchanged GPU policy/load/power/cooling state and apply only the approved boundary/window rule. Stop without retry on missing, duplicate, swapped, stale or divergent data; perform no load or mutation.
test_case.expected_result: All eight `_M` identities have explicit independent outcomes distinct from the non-M family. Each applicable OOB record and both UI views agree with the Project-defined physical component, monitor channel, electrical boundary, quantity, units, value, supported threshold fields, health and freshness and satisfy the approved passive-state rule. Zero/unavailable for absent or powered-off hardware is valid only when specified; no guessed meaning or dynamic stimulus is used.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the authoritative `_M` definition, eight component/monitor mappings and complete independent OOB/two-UI evidence accepted against boundary/state/window-specific rules. A literal range, truncated inventory, count, non-M data, guessed memory/module meaning, generic watt limit or host reading from another boundary cannot pass. Missing/swapped/duplicate/stale identity, wrong component/boundary/unit/scaling, out-of-rule value or required UI/status/threshold mismatch is FAIL. Missing `_M` definition, topology, monitor reference or acceptance is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS. Load response and threshold assert/deassert remain separate cases.
safety_gate: Do not clear SEL, XID, kernel, power or thermal logs; existing evidence is part of the passive state.
Do not infer `_M` as memory, motherboard or module, and do not substitute the adjacent non-M family.
Map all eight by physical component plus serial/UUID/BDF and exact monitor channel; GPU index alone is insufficient.
Do not start workload, change persistence/clocks/cap/power state/firmware/thresholds, reset/power-cycle/reseat hardware or alter cooling.
Do not guess OEM parameters, compare unlike boundaries/windows, truncate output, expose credentials or execute an unreviewed Script; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Chassis/GPU-baseboard/BIOS/BMC/monitor identity, authoritative `_M` definition and explicit non-M distinction
Per-record electrical boundary and controller/bus/mux/address/channel/register/scaling/window map with stable SDR/UI identity
Complete separate raw values, units, supported thresholds, health and synchronized timestamps plus matching Dashboard and Server Health visual evidence
Recorded driver/persistence/clocks/cap/processes/workload/fan/inlet/airflow and boundary/time-aligned rule application or approved corroboration
Missing/swapped/powered-off/stale/divergent disposition, Script/client audit, no-clear/no-load-or-policy-change/no-retry proof, final GPU/BMC health and eight-channel engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is planned. If `_M`, component mapping, boundary or sampling semantics are unknown, or readings diverge, stop and preserve first-pass evidence and current GPU/power/cooling context. Obtain the platform power-tree and monitor references before further read-only collection; do not create workload or change GPU state to diagnose this row. Any separate stimulated test requires its own approval, safety gate and recovery.

source_conflict.reason: The `_M` expansion and electrical boundary are underdefined, but Items, UI Procedure and Criteria consistently request passive display/specification validation. Adjacent non-M and dynamic cases are distinct coverage, not conflicting instructions.

blocked.reason: The passive eight-point objective and safe parameterized method are clear. Project power-tree/controller documentation can bind `_M`, topology and acceptance at execution readiness.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Authoritative `_M` versus non-M definition, eight physical GPU/component/UUID/BDF/monitor mappings, electrical boundary, scaling/window, stable IDs, state-specific limit/threshold/status/freshness/powered-off rules, passive GPU context and protected reviewed method.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; READ ONLY; NO GPU LOAD, POLICY, POWER, FIRMWARE, THRESHOLD OR COOLING CHANGE; SCRIPT NOT APPROVED
